evidence.observation: Growth-stage pressure was 3.045 Torr at 99.5 sccm Ar.
Pressure has risen persistently to 3.338 Torr despite essentially unchanged Ar flow (99.1 sccm) and temperature (749.5 °C versus 750 °C setpoint).
Exhaust O2 sensor is not installed; oxygen readings remain unavailable, preventing verification of the growth atmosphere.

args.missing_evidence: No sample characterization yet. Independent pressure verification and leak/exhaust-conductance checks are needed to identify the pressure-rise cause; a functioning exhaust O2 sensor is needed to verify the required atmosphere.
